details:
RootRise – AI-Powered Agricultural Decision-Support Platform

RootRise is an innovative AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make smarter, more sustainable, and data-driven farming decisions. The project focuses on addressing major agricultural challenges, including soil degradation, water scarcity, climate change, declining soil fertility, and inefficient crop rotation practices, particularly in arid and climate-vulnerable regions such as Egypt and the Nile Delta.

The platform aims to combine satellite observations, environmental and climate data, soil characteristics, and agricultural information to generate intelligent crop rotation recommendations tailored to individual farms.

How It Works:

RootRise is designed to collect and analyze several types of data, including:

  • Satellite observations and vegetation indices such as NDVI and EVI.
  • Climate information, including temperature, rainfall, and drought indicators.
  • Soil characteristics such as pH, salinity, organic matter, and nutrient levels.
  • Crop characteristics, including water requirements, growing seasons, and nitrogen fixation capabilities.
  • Historical agricultural records and farmers' priorities.

Using this information, the proposed AI decision-support engine will evaluate different crop rotation strategies and compare them based on water conservation, soil health, agricultural productivity, climate resilience, and economic feasibility. It will provide farmers with understandable recommendations, explain the advantages and disadvantages of each strategy, and highlight potential agricultural risks.

Technology and Tools:

The planned technology stack includes Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, GeoPandas, Rasterio, NumPy, and Pandas. The project also proposes integrating publicly available Earth observation and environmental datasets from NASA Earthdata, Landsat, MODIS, SMAP, and NASA POWER API.

The initial AI architecture is designed around an explainable hybrid decision-support system combining agricultural rule-based filtering and multi-criteria weighted scoring. This approach prioritizes transparency and scientifically explainable recommendations rather than relying entirely on black-box predictions.

Benefits and Expected Impact:

RootRise aims to:

  1. Reduce unnecessary agricultural water consumption through better crop selection and rotation planning.
  2. Improve soil fertility and support sustainable agricultural practices.
  3. Help farmers adapt to changing climate conditions and environmental risks.
  4. Reduce unnecessary fertilizer and agricultural input costs.
  5. Make satellite and scientific environmental data more accessible to small and medium-sized farmers.
  6. Support food security and long-term agricultural sustainability.

Innovation and Creativity:

The main innovation of RootRise is its integration of satellite-based Earth observation, climate intelligence, soil science, and AI-powered decision support into one accessible platform. Instead of simply displaying environmental data, the platform is designed to transform complex scientific information into practical, understandable agricultural strategies.

Development Status:

RootRise is currently in its conceptual and architectural planning phase. Its software architecture, proposed technologies, data sources, and development roadmap have been defined. The implementation of the application and its AI decision-support engine is planned as the next development stage.

Our long-term vision is to contribute to more sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture by connecting space-based environmental intelligence with real-world farming decisions.
